tier1.text: Each dorsalis pedis artery branches many times to send blood to the top of the foot. This artery comes from the anterior tibial artery, which feeds the front of the lower leg. With other foot arteries, the dorsalis pedis artery forms two arches that feed the rest of the foot and the toes.

quotes.quote: There is an anastomosis with the dorsalis pedis artery, and the medial and lateral plantar arteries form two arches called the dorsal arch (also called the arcuate arch) and the plantar arch, which provide blood to the remainder of the foot and toes.
